ECI allows voters to re-enroll if name was deleted for not filling SIR form

The Election Commission of India (ECI) has provided an opportunity for voters whose names were deleted from the electoral roll for not filling the 'SIR' form to get their names re-enrolled. Special camps were organized in areas like Patratu to facilitate this process, allowing individuals to submit Form-6 for inclusion in the voter list.
